AOC-CR-298's conviction table is two rows of six cells - FileNumber, ArrestDate, OffenseDescription, DateOfOffense, Disposition, DispositionDate, indexed :1 and :2 in the source's own field names, with cell rectangles read from the document's own rule strokes. All twelve cells are blank in both fixtures. Row 1's six cells are declared required-before-filing and all six are disclosed with the record each column comes from; row 2's six cells are declared optional participant content with the basis 'the form's own second row, used only if more than one nonviolent misdemeanor conviction is listed on this petition', and the guide tells the participant to use AOC-CR-285 beyond that. AOC-CV-226's asset and liability rows are likewise entirely blank, every figure declared the participant's own. So no row anywhere in this packet carries a written cell beside a required cell left blank - the failure mode this obligation exists for cannot arise here, because no row carries any written cell at all.

Each delivered page's content stream contains its own source page's content stream byte-for-byte: pages 1, 2, 4 and 5 decompose into the two bytes 'q\n', then the source page verbatim, then a trailing block whose only operators are q, cm, Do and Q - 6319, 2951, 5637 and 1126 bytes of pure widget placement. So no drawing operator was added anywhere outside a flattened widget appearance, and the AOC's own ink is untouched. Every placement was then checked against the sources: 185 placements in each fixture against 185 widget rectangles read first hand from the two fillable PDFs, every one an identity matrix at its widget's own origin with an appearance BBox equal to that widget's width and height - 185 of 185, zero mismatches, in both fixtures. FILING_DESTINATION.measured: The guide names the office the route names and gives both authorities for it: 'File with the clerk of superior court in the county where the charge was brought. That is the committed packet-set manifest's instruction for this packet, and the committed track record names the same office and the same venue: Superior Court of the county where the charge was brought.' It also tells the participant to check the county the platform wrote into the caption against the county of conviction, that the District / Superior division boxes in the caption are theirs, and - for the multi-county case G.S. 15A-145.5(c4) contemplates - that sequencing across counties is a question to take to a North Carolina lawyer before the first filing rather than one this packet answers.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.measured: Both stated, both sourced, and the waiver is not merely named but delivered. Fee: '$175.00 per petition', the committed manifest's own words, corroborated on the form's own face - 'NOTE: This petition requires the payment of a filing fee unless the petitioner is an indigent', which is printed on delivered page 1. Waiver: AOC-CV-226 is IN this packet as pages 4 and 5, conditional on the participant seeking it, and the manifest's terms are quoted - 'available on AOC-CV-226, including for petitioners receiving SNAP, TANF or SSI or represented by a legal services organization'. The guide also carries the manifest's separate-costs position - the costs of expunging records under G.S. 15A-150 are not taxed against the petitioner - and warns that 'per petition' means the fee is charged in each county if G.S. 15A-145.5(c4) means more than one filing, with an instruction to ask each clerk first.

SERVICE.measured: Recipient and method are both answered from the form itself, and the timing rule that depends on them is carried. Recipient: the district attorney. Method: the guide names all four the form offers - personal delivery to the district attorney, leaving a copy at the office with an associate or employee, deposit in a postpaid properly addressed envelope with the U.S. Postal Service, and email from ICMS/OFS to the district attorney's email address of record with the court. The guide states why the packet completes none of it: 'A certificate of service states that service HAS been made. Completing it before you serve would make it untrue on the day you sign it', and that is borne out in the bytes - every certificate-of-service widget is empty. It carries the manifest's position that no other service is stated on this route, with the manifest's own confirm-before-release caveat, the form's NOTE TO CLERK that the hearing may not be scheduled earlier than 30 days after service on the district attorney, and the one delivery duty that is NOT on the certificate of service: the ORDER's paragraph 1(b), under which any other State or local government agency expunges on receiving a copy of the order from the petitioner.

SELF_HELP_STOP.measured: The packet states where self-help ends, at three levels. A ten-item 'When to stop and get help' list drawn from the committed track record - any offence that might be Class A1, Class A through G felony, DWI, a sex offence or on the enumerated exclusion list; any other non-traffic conviction anywhere, which the record calls an absolute bar; any prior G.S. 15A-145.5 expunction; outstanding restitution; pending charges; a district attorney objection; the good-character affidavits, which need third parties and are not in this packet; out-of-state or federal convictions needing equivalency analysis; any immigration matter, because an expunction can harm an immigration case by destroying record access; and offence classification itself. A 'What this packet does not tell you, and who does' section that states, rather than hides, the limits of the build - including that the full enumerated exclusion list of G.S. 15A-145.5(a) has not been read at the official source and is encoded nowhere in this packet, and that the session law number for the 2025 three-year change is held as a release blocker so the packet cites none. And a closing 'What this packet is not' that names the three documents it is not: AOC-CR-297, AOC-CR-285, and the G.S. 15A-145.5(c1) affidavits.

observationsFromTheBytes.what: The committed manifest locates the good-character affidavits at a section of AOC-CR-298 that the pinned form does not carry. The packet prints the record's line verbatim, as it must, and corrects the impression in its own words.
observationsFromTheBytes.measured: The committed packet-set manifest's requiredBeforeFiling carries 'The good-character affidavits - AOC-CR-298, affidavit section.' and its participantActionRequired carries 'Ask people who know you to complete the affidavit section of the form.' Read against the pinned AOC-CR-298 (8f526257...), the form has no affidavit section: the word 'affidavit' appears three times only - paragraph 3 'I have attached to this petition the affidavits required by G.S. 15A-145.5(c1)', the certification sentence beneath it, and Side Two finding 11, which refers to affidavits the Court has reviewed. The delivered guide prints the manifest line verbatim in its 18-item list, as the build contract requires, and separately tells the participant the true position twice: 'This packet does not contain the affidavits paragraph 3 certifies you have attached... You obtain them; nothing in this packet is one', and in the documents table, 'these are other people's sworn statements, not yours, and none of them is in this packet'.
observationsFromTheBytes.consequence: No obligation fails. The participant is not sent looking for a section that does not exist without being told, and the packet does not invent an affidavit. The defect is in the committed manifest's own wording, not in the packet, and it belongs to whoever owns data/record-clearing/legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json. This lane does not edit that file.

The good-character affidavit request is guidance for the same reason'.
